mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_code_artifact ( user_id, provider, artifact_type, repository, external_id, canonical_url, changed_files, additions, deletions, artifact_state, merged, ownership_verified, github_author_id, github_committer_id, source_observed_at, verified_at, deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{artifactType}, #{repository}, #{externalId}, #{canonicalUrl}, #{changedFiles}, #{additions}, #{deletions}, #{artifactState}, #{merged}, #{ownershipVerified}, #{githubAuthorId}, #{githubCommitterId}, #{sourceObservedAt}, #{verifiedAt}, 0, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE canonical_url = VALUES(canonical_url), changed_files = VALUES(changed_files), additions = VALUES(additions), deletions = VALUES(deletions), artifact_state = VALUES(artifact_state), merged = VALUES(merged), ownership_verified = VALUES(ownership_verified), github_author_id = VALUES(github_author_id), github_committer_id = VALUES(github_committer_id), source_observed_at = VALUES(source_observed_at), verified_at = VALUES(verified_at), deleted = 0, update_time = NOW()
